name: Monica Aleman Gibbs
office: Three Valleys Municipal Water District, Member, Board of Directors, Division 3

items.text: Monica Aleman Gibbs is a water consultant and educator running for Division 3 of the Three Valleys Municipal Water District Board of Directors. Her campaign says she will prioritize investing in infrastructure and water quality. She supports expanding groundwater storage and diversifying the water supply with recycled water. She also supports clear communication about how water is delivered and billed.
